channel.title: Chat | System Design
channel.description: In-depth system design tutorials — from zero to millions of users. Written for engineers who want to understand how large-scale systems actually work.

item.title: Design a Chat System
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: Build a Messenger-style chat system for 50 million daily users. Why WebSocket beats polling, how server-assigned sequence numbers guarantee ordering, multi-device sync, presence with heartbeats, and the reconnect problems that only appear in production.
